title: 6. Security mistakes in HITL
summary: 1. Anyone can approve an action. 2. Approval links are not authenticated. 3. The approved action changes before execution. 4. Approval never expires. 5. The same person requests and approves a sensitive action when separation of duties is required. 6. Approval is recorded, but the backend does not enforce it. 7. The…
objectives: Explain every point in “6. Security mistakes in HITL” with clear language
Use the flow diagram to see what happens one step after another
Connect the visual flow to the written explanation and code

sections.title: Overview
sections.body:
1. Anyone can approve an action.
2. Approval links are not authenticated.
3. The approved action changes before execution.
4. Approval never expires.
5. The same person requests and approves a sensitive action when separation of duties is required.
6. Approval is recorded, but the backend does not enforce it.
7. The agent can bypass the approval node and call the tool directly.

quiz.question: What is the most production-ready mindset for "6. Security mistakes in HITL"?
options: Trust fluent model output without checks
Define detect → mitigate → validate loops around the concept
Only optimize prompts and ignore systems design
quiz.explanation: Production GenAI systems need explicit detection, mitigation, and validation around every critical concept.
